messages:
sre-bot: PAGER — metering: heuristic fallback detected in token counter (eu-west1). Severity: P1. Large delta vs baseline; multiple overage flags emitted. See alert: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/mtg
ama: seeing the spike on token_delta.50m, starts at ~1765439900. overage flags correlate with aggregator restarts.
mike: I'm oncall, pulling logs now. I'll take incident lead.
jess: ping billing & CS, cc @raj. any customer-facing impact yet?
mike: initial grep shows this switch: \n```
2025-11-12T14:39:57Z svc=metering comp=heuristic reason="error: timeout" fallback=legacy_smoother heuristic_switch=true
```
looks like token_rate_smoother_v2 fell back to legacy_smoother; counts doubled for a short window.
sre-bot: heuristic: token_rate_smoother_v2 -> legacy_smoother; recent config rollout at 14:30 UTC. Auto-fallback trigged by p99 latency > 800ms.
raj: support queue has 2 tickets referencing unexpected overage emails. both from EU customers; one high-value. jess can we pause notifications?
jess: yes, will queue a temporary suppress for billing notifications. doing now.
mike: checking pods: \n```
$ kubectl -n metering get pods -o wide | egrep "aggregator|emitter"
aggregator-5f7d9   2/2 Running   1 (1 restarted)  10.1.7.3
emitter-cc4a1     0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  5 (5 restarts)
```
emitter is flapping; likely caused fallback load. I'll scale emitter to 4 and pin heuristic to legacy until stable.
oncall: mike, please coordinate the feature flag toggle with deploys team before changing prod flag.
mike: doing feature-flag toggle now: \n```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"token_rate_smoother_v2","state":"off","reason":"fallback-causing-overcount"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```
(small change) patch applied at 14:47 UTC.
ama: metrics after toggle: token_delta spike flattened within ~4 minutes; overage-flag rate down ~87%.
raj: CS: create temporary credits for the two affected customers and draft an email saying we throttled billing notifications and are reconciling usage. I'll review.
jess: suppress worked. I also opened a short incident page for billing ops.
sre-bot: runbook note: if heuristic fallback occurs, immediate tasks: 1) pin flag, 2) scale emitter, 3) kick replay job. Link: https://runbooks.internal/metering/heuristic-fallback
mike: kicked replay job for 14:30-14:50 window (job-id: replay-1765439). verifying emit backlog now.

mike: replay progress: 60% complete, no errors. emitter restarts reduced after scale.
ama: final metrics: token_delta back to baseline; late-emits count elevated but decreasing. estimate full reconciliation in ~2 hours.
jess: drafting customer comms and internal postmortem stub. assigning follow-ups: root cause (config rollout testing) -> eng-ml; improve circuit-breaker -> eng-runtime; CS credits -> finance.
raj: thanks all. any action for today? mike: follow up on replay completion and postmortem doc. I'll update when replay done.
sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied at 1765439867-1765439869 window; metrics normalized by 1765440001. No persistent data loss. Recommended next steps posted to incident page.
jess: marking incident as mitigated; keeping in-monitoring for 2h. :white_check_mark:
